verdict.rationale: Ente ships an official CLI that can automatically back up Auth codes and decrypt Auth exports, so some headless, scriptable automation is first-party. However, the documented headless surface covers only export and backup. Nothing shows the core authenticator functions running non-interactively or in CI. Missing for 10: headless TOTP code generation or retrieval, documented CI usage or non-interactive auth flows, CLI command reference depth, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
Utility for exporting data from Ente and decrypt the export from Ente Auth
This means you can go ahead and script a workflow that works for you.
